title: Local worker claims and narrates with first TTS backend
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Local worker thin slice
  Scenario: Local worker wins claim and marks done
    Given a pending job and a running auritus worker
    When the worker polls claimable and claims the job
    Then it runs the configured TTSBackend locally
    And uploads audio
    And marks the job done before the cloud fallback timeout
```

## Implementation brief
1. cli/src/auritus/worker/daemon.py + tts/base.py + tts/higgs.py.
2. Verify Higgs license in docs/MODEL_LICENSES.md; runtime-fetch weights.
3. Thin-slice acceptance via example page.
